# ILog <Badge type="info" text="interface" />

<p class="api-meta">Namespace <code>Lustral</code> · Assembly <code>Lustral.Api</code></p>

A log whose messages are tagged with their source. Messages are written to `Lustral/Logs/latest.log` and, when enabled, to the console window.

```csharp
public interface ILog
```

## Remarks

Messages may contain Unity rich text tags, which the console window renders and log files omit: `<color=red>` or `<color=#ff8800>` (a Unity color name, or `#rgb`/`#rrggbb` with optional alpha), `<b>`, `<i>`, `<u>` and `<s>`, each with a closing tag: `log.Info("Health: <color=red>low</color>")`. As in Unity, a tag without a closing tag is written as plain text.

## Methods

### Debug(string) {#debug}

```csharp
void Debug(string message);
```

Writes a debug message. Debug messages are written only when the log level is Debug.

### Error(string, Exception) {#error}

```csharp
void Error(string message, Exception? exception = null);
```

Writes an error, including the exception and its stack trace if one is given.

